geo.title: Get started
geo.body:
Explore: measure paths from a point to a road and conjecture which is shortest (proved in 5.3).

Goal: I can construct a perpendicular through a point on and off a line.

slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
To construct the perpendicular from a point P off line l: draw an arc centered at P that crosses l at two points A and B. From A and B, draw arcs with equal radius that cross on the far side of l at Q. Line PQ is perpendicular to l.

For a point P on l: mark points A and B on l equally far from P, then construct the perpendicular bisector of AB. It passes through P. Explore now: of all the segments from P to l, which seems shortest? We prove it is the perpendicular one in 5.3.
